decision_conditions: The development hereby permitted shall be begun not later than 29th March 2021 which is the expiry date of the original planning permission ref 17/03059/FUL as varied by 18/04890/VAR Reason: To comply with the provisions of Section 91(1)(a) of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 as amended by the Planning and Compulsory Purchase Act 2004

Unless required by any other condition attached to this Decision, the development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans: 30803-MSA-B1-ZZ-DR-A-0010_P0230803-MSA-B2-ZZ-DR-A-0011_P0230803-MSA-B3-ZZ-DR-A-0012_P03AC0000813445Area measurement report, ref: 44700, dated 14.02.2020Transport Assessment, ref: HD216-R001 Rev A, dated 13.10.2025Reason: For the avoidance of doubt and in the interests of proper planning.

The development shall be carried out and maintained strictly in accordance with drawings ENFLD-FRH-S0-XX-DR-C-2001, ENFLD-FRH-S0-XX-DR-C-2002, ENFLD-FRH-S0-XX-DR-C-2016 and ENFLD-FRH-S0-XX-DR-C-2017, unless otherwise agreed in writing.Reason: To provide a sufficient level of detail to ensure that levels have appropriate regard to the level of surrounding development, gradients and surface water drainage

The materials to be used on the buildings hereby approved shall match those on Drawing Nos.30803-PL-125A, 30803-PL-126A, 30803-PL-127B, unless written permission is otherwise granted by the Local Planning Authority.Reason: To secure a satisfactory appearance in the interest of visual amenity.

The site shall be enclosed in accordance with details to be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The means of enclosure shall be erected in accordance with the approved detail before the development is occupied.For the purposes of this condition, the details submitted to the Local Planning Authority under reference 19/02897/CND on 12.09.2019 shall be deemed to be approved.Reason: To ensure satisfactory appearance and safeguard the privacy, amenity and safety of adjoining occupiers and the public and in the interest of highway safety.

The visibility splays for the access roads and junctions associated with the development shall be provided prior to occupation of the site and thereafter maintained.Reason: To ensure that the development complies with adopted Policy and does not prejudice conditions of safety or traffic flow on adjoining highways.

Unless required by any other condition attached to this permission, the hard-surfacing materials to be used throughout the development hereby approved, inclusive of footpaths, access roads, parking areas, and road markings, shall match those on Drawing No.30803-PL-128D. The surfacing shall be carried out in accordance with the approved plan before the development is occupied or use commences, unless otherwise agreed in writing.Reason: To ensure that the development does not prejudice highway safety and a satisfactory appearance

Notwithstanding any submitted plan, and unless required by any other condition attached to this permission, the parking and turning areas shall be laid out as shown on Drawing No.30803-PL- 121D prior to use commencing or occupation and permanently retained and kept free from obstruction for such purposes unless written permission is otherwise granted by the Local Planning Authority.Reason: To ensure a satisfactory appearance and to ensure that parking and turning facilities are provided.

Notwithstanding the submitted plans prior to their installation typical details, including siting and design of plugs, of the electric vehicle charging points to be provided, shall be submitted to the Local Planning Authority for approval in writing. All electric charging points shall be installed in accordance with the approved details prior to first occupation of the development and permanently maintained and retained.For the purposes of this condition, the details submitted to the Local Planning Authority under reference 19/02897/CND on 12.09.2019 shall be deemed to be approved.Reason: To ensure that the development complies with adopted Policy.

The development shall be carried out and maintained in accordance with drawing 30803 PL 136 A (bin stores).Reason: In the interest of visual amenity and the recycling of waste materials in support of the Boroughs waste reduction targets.

The approved cycle storage provision as shown on drawing 30803 PL 135A shall be installed prior to the first occupation and shall be permanently maintained as such thereafter, unless otherwise agreed in writing. Reason: To provide secure cycle storage facilities free from obstruction in the interest of promoting sustainable travel.

Prior to occupation details in relation to external lighting shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning. Details shall include:a. Design, size, siting;b. Measures to limit the impact of light spillage onto light sensitive receptors such as the vegetated buffer strip and River Lee NavigationThe approved lighting shall be provided in accordance with the approved details prior to first occupation of any of the units hereby approved.For the purposes of this condition, the details submitted to the Local Planning Authority under reference 19/02897/CND on 12.09.2019 shall be deemed to be approved.Reason: In the interest of visual amenity due to the location of the development adjacent to the Metropolitan Green Belt and to minimise disruption to wildlife friendly habitats and foraging bats.

The development hereby approved shall only be laid out as three units and shall not be further subdivided and occupied by separate businesses unless written permission is otherwise granted by the Local Planning Authority.Reason: To ensure that the development complies with adopted parking and servicing standards in the interests of highway safety

Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 2015 or in any statutory instrument revoking and re-enacting that Order with or without modification, the unit(s) hereby approved shall only be used for purposes within Use Classes B1c, B2 and B8 as defined by Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) Order 1987, and shall not be used for any other purpose whatsoever unless written permission is otherwise granted by the Local Planning Authority.Reason: To ensure the use of the units comply with London Plan Policies, Core Strategy Policies and the Development Management Document given the sites location within Strategic Industrial Land.

All areas of trees, hedges, scrub or similar vegetation where birds may nest which are to be removed as part of the development, are to be cleared outside the bird-nesting season (March - August inclusive) or if clearance during the bird-nesting season cannot reasonably be avoided, a suitably qualified ecologist will check the areas to be removed immediately prior to clearance and advise whether nesting birds are present. If active nests are recorded, no vegetation clearance or other works that may disturb active nests shall proceed until all young have fledged the nest. Reason: Nesting birds are protected under the Wildlife & Countryside Act, 1981 (as amended), this condition will ensure that wildlife is not adversely affected by the proposed development.

The development shall be carried out and maintained in accordance with drawings: 19-01 Rev A - Southwest, 29-01 Rev B - Southeast, 39-01 Rev E - North East and 49-01 Rev B - North West (Landscaping), unless otherwise agreed in writing. Reason: In the interests of amenity, having regard to the river setting and the adjoining Green Belt and in order to provide appropriate footpath links through the employment area.

The development shall be carried out and maintained strictly in accordance with the approved documents under application reference number 18/03779/CND (Construction Management).Reason: In the interests of amenity, having regard to the river setting and the adjoining Green Belt and in order to provide appropriate footpath links through the employment area.

Unless required by any other condition attached to this permission, the development shall be undertaken in accordance with the submitted Construction Environmental Management Plan (Version 2), unless written permission is otherwise granted by the Local Planning Authority.Reason: To minimise the impact of construction activity on the natural and built environment.

The development shall be carried out and maintained strictly in accordance with the approved documents under application reference number 18/03779/CND (Waste Management Plan).Reason: To maximise the amount of waste diverted from landfill consistent with the waste hierarchy and strategic targets.

In accordance with the submitted 'Energy Strategy' the energy efficiency of the development shall provide for savings of no less than 40.89% total CO2 emissions arising from the operation of the development and its services over Part L of Building Regs 2013.The development shall be carried out strictly in accordance with the details so approved and maintained as such thereafter.  For the purposes of this condition, the details submitted to the Local Planning Authority under reference 19/01099/CND on 13.05.2019 shall be deemed to be approved.Reason: In the interest of sustainable development and to ensure that the Local Planning Authority is satisfied that CO2 emission reduction targets by renewable energy are met in accordance with DMD51, DMD53 of the Development Management Document, and having regard to the savings identified in the submitted documentation.

The development shall be carried out and maintained strictly in accordance with the approved documents under application reference number 19/01099/CND (Low Carbon Technologies).Reason: In the interest of sustainable development and to ensure that the Local Planning Authority may be satisfied that CO2 emission reduction targets by renewable energy are met.

Following practical completion of works a final Energy Performance Certificate shall be submitted to an approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. Where applicable, a Display Energy Certificate shall be submitted within 18 months following first occupation.For the purposes of this condition, the details submitted to the Local Planning Authority under reference 20/01203/CND on 07.05.2020 shall be deemed to be approved.Reason: In the interest of sustainable development and to ensure that the Local Planning Authority may be satisfied that CO2 emission reduction targets are met

The remediation recommendations put forward in the Site Investigation shall be fully implemented and a verification report demonstrating that the remediation has been fully completed shall be submitted for approval to the local planning authority prior to any occupation of the site taking place.For the purposes of this condition, the details submitted to the Local Planning Authority under reference 20/01027/CND on 07.04.2020 shall be deemed to be approved.Reason: To protect against risks arising from contamination.

If, during development, contamination not previously identified is found to be present at the site then no further development (unless otherwise agreed in writing with the Local Planning Authority) shall be carried out until a remediation strategy detailing how this contamination will be dealt with has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The remediation strategy shall be implemented as approved.For the purposes of this condition, the details submitted to the Local Planning Authority under reference 20/01027/CND on 07.04.2020 shall be deemed to be approved.Reason: To ensure that the development is not put at unacceptable risk from, or adversely affected by, unacceptable levels water pollution from previously unidentified contamination sources at the development site and to prevent deterioration of a water quality element to a lower status class within the groundwater present in the River Terrace Gravels or the underlying Tertiary and Chalk aquifers.

Where refuelling facilities are proposed, works shall not commence until such time as a scheme to agree pollution prevention measures for the storage of pollutants has been submitted to, and approved in writing by, the Local Planning Authority. The scheme shall be implemented as approved.Reason: The site is located within a SPZ therefore to prevent risk to groundwater resources additional information is required on the potential activity and storage of substances which may cause harm to groundwater resources.

A scheme for managing any borehole installed for the investigation of soils, groundwater or geotechnical purposes shall be submitted to the Local Planning Authority for approval in writing. The scheme shall provide details of:a. how redundant boreholes are to be decommissioned; andb. how any boreholes that need to be retained, post-development, for monitoringpurposes will be secured, protected and inspected.The scheme as approved shall be implemented prior to first occupation.For the purposes of this condition, the details submitted to the Local Planning Authority under reference 19/02897/CND on 12.09.2019 shall be deemed to be approved.Reason: To ensure that redundant boreholes are safe and secure, and do not cause groundwater pollution or loss of water supplies by providing preferential pathways for contaminant movement which poses a risk to groundwater quality.

The development shall be carried out and maintained strictly in accordance with the approved documents under application reference number 18/03779/CND (Piling).Reason: To ensure that the proposed piled foundations does not harm groundwater resources and to ensure that any piling does not cause preferential pathways for contaminants to migrate to groundwater and cause pollution.

All Non-Road Mobile Machinery (NRMM) of net power of 37kW and up to and including 560kW used during the course of the demolition, site preparation and construction phases shall comply with the emission standards set out in chapter 7 of the Mayor's supplementary planning guidance (SPG) Control of Dust and Emissions DuringConstruction and Demolition dated July 2014, or subsequent guidance.Unless it complies with the standards set out in the SPG, no NRMM shall be on site, at any time, whether in use or not, without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.The developer shall keep an up-to-date list of all NRMM used during the demolition, site preparation and construction phases of the development on the online register at https://nrmm.london/Reason: To protect local amenity and air quality.

The development shall be carried out and maintained strictly in accordance with drawings ENFLD-FRH-S0-XX-DR-C-2011 and ENFLD-FRH-S0-XX-DR-C-2012 (Drainage), unless otherwise agreed in writing. Reason: To prevent pollution and to improve water quality, in accordance with adopted Policy.

No infiltration of surface water drainage into the ground at the site is permitted other than with the express written consent of the Local Planning Authority, which may be given for those parts of the site where it has been demonstrated that there is no resultant unacceptable risk to groundwater. The development shall be carried out in accordance with the approval details. Reason: To protect groundwater quality because the site is located on made ground due to several contaminative uses and poses a risk to the groundwater receptors. Installation of soakaways or the use of infiltration techniques could create pathways for new contamination or mobilise existing contamination within the site.

No plant, machinery, goods, products or waste material shall be deposited or stored on any open part of the site unless written permission is otherwise granted by the Local Planning Authority.Reason: In the interest of amenity and the appearance of the site.

Development shall only commence in accordance with the details provided within the submitted information prepared by Elcot Environmental in relation to the management and control of Himalayan Balsam, Floating Pennywort and Japanese Knotweed on the site. Development shall proceed in accordance with the approved method statement. Reason: To prevent the spread of invasive species and to ensure that appropriate mitigation and remediation is undertaken

The development shall be carried out and maintained strictly in accordance with the approved documents under application reference number 18/01925/CND (Secured by Design) approved on 28.12.2018Reason: to mitigate the impact of crime and deliver a safer development in line with adopted policy.

Prior to the first occupation of each unit, a 'Secured by Design' accreditation shall be obtained for each unit, with confirmation of accreditation to be submitted to the Local Planning Authority.For the purposes of this condition, the details submitted to the Local Planning Authority under reference 20/01203/CND on 07.05.2020 shall be deemed to be approved.Reason: to mitigate the impact of crime and deliver a safer development in line with adopted policy.
